name: Ferienwohnung Baumgartner Hertha
beschreibung:
Peacefully and sunnily situated in Ebbs, Ferienwohnung Baumgartner Hertha provides comfortable holiday living with scenic vistas of the Kaiser mountain range. Guests value the personal touch and well-maintained rooms.

The local area invites relaxed walks, riverside cycling along the Inn, and climbing or hiking in the surrounding Alps.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnung Baumgartner Hertha in Ebbs offers restful days and welcoming hospitality in Kufsteinerland.
